headline: Uzbekistan and Jordan are moving from diplomacy to economics
summary: Uzbekistan and Jordan launched direct flights, formed a business council and prepared a preferential trade agreement following King Abdullah II's 2025 visit. A Mirziyoyev visit to Amman could broaden ties further.
why: Preferential trade agreements and direct air links lower costs and open new export routes, which matters for companies trading between Central Asia and the Middle East.
original_headline: O‘zbekiston va Iordaniya diplomatiyadan iqtisodiyotga o‘tmoqda
